bank_name: First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC – IBU

website_metadata.notes: First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC operates as a wholesale/corporate bank in India (1 onshore branch, Mumbai) plus a GIFT City IFSC Banking Unit. No public GIFT-City / IFSC retail deposit rate card is published; bankfab.com publishes only UAE-domestic Smart Deposit / Fixed Deposit products (en-ae). India IBU deposit (FX) rates are relationship-managed, not published. Web search surfaced only other banks' IBU rate cards (Axis, Federal, ICICI GIFT City) and FAB's UAE retail products.

warnings: Wholesale IBU; no public GIFT-City retail/FX deposit rate card. Only UAE-domestic FAB deposit products are published online.
